```{r}
rrbs_plot_eg <- function(read_data_path_a, chrom, region_start, region_end, cpgs = cg_sites,
                       jit_amount = 0.1) {
  set.seed(42)

  # ── 1. Read only the matching rows — never loads unmatched data into RAM ───
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
  on.exit(dbDisconnect(con))
  
  read_data_a <- dbGetQuery(con, glue::glue("
    SELECT *
    FROM read_parquet('{read_data_path_a}')
    WHERE seqnames = '{chrom}'
      AND \"start\" >= {region_start}
      AND \"end\"   <= {region_end}
  "))
  
  
  read_data_a$type <- "healthy"
  
  read_data <- read_data_a
  
  jitter_amount <- runif(nrow(read_data), -jit_amount, jit_amount)
  read_data$alpha_jit <- read_data$alpha + jitter_amount
  read_data <- data.frame(read_data)
  
  read_data <- read_data %>% mutate(alpha_group = case_when(alpha < 0.2 ~ "a < 0.2",
                                 alpha > 0.8 ~ "a > 0.8",
                                 alpha >= 0.2 & alpha <= 0.4 ~ "0.2 <= a <= 0.4",
                                 alpha > 0.4 & alpha < 0.6 ~ "0.4 < a < 0.6",
                                 TRUE ~ "0.6 <= a <= 0.8"))
  read_data <- read_data %>% mutate(alpha_group = factor(alpha_group, levels = c("a < 0.2", "0.2 <= a <= 0.4", "0.4 < a < 0.6", "0.6 <= a <= 0.8", "a > 0.8")))
  
  # Add jittered coordinates to new columns in the data frame
  long_data <- read_data %>%
    mutate(meth_status = strsplit(meth_pattern, ""), start = strsplit(genom_positions, ",")) %>%
    unnest(meth_status, start) %>%
    mutate(start = as.double(start))

  chr <- unique(read_data$seqnames)
  min_start <- min(read_data$read_start)
  max_end <- max(read_data$read_end)
  
  plot <- read_data %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_segment(aes(x = read_start, xend = read_end,
                     y = alpha_jit, yend = alpha_jit, colour = alpha_group)) +
    geom_point(data = long_data,
               aes(x = start, y = alpha_jit,
                   fill = meth_status, colour = alpha_group), shape = 21) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("U" = "white", "M" = "black")) +
    facet_wrap(~ type, nrow=2) +
    labs(title = paste0(chr, ":", min_start, "-", max_end)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "genomic position")
  plot
}
```


```{r}
geom_beta <- function(all_b, style = "line", plot.space=1, plot.height=1) {
    structure(list(all_b = all_b, style = style, plot.space = plot.space,
        plot.height = plot.height),
        class = "beta"
    )
}

ggplot_add.beta <- function(object, plot, object_name) {
plot2 <- plot
    while (inherits(plot2, "patchwork")) {
        plot2 <- plot2[[1]]
    }
    plot.data <- plot2$labels$title
    plot.data <- stringr::str_split_1(plot.data, ":")
    # prepare plot range
    # the plot region are not normal, so start is minimum value
    plot.chr <- plot.data[1]
    plot.data <- stringr::str_split_1(plot.data[2], "-")
    plot.region.start <- plot.data[1] %>% as.numeric()
    plot.region.end <- plot.data[2] %>% as.numeric()
    
    all_b <- object$all_b
    plot.space <- object$plot.space
    plot.height <- object$plot.height
    style <- object$style
    
 #   all_b <- all_b %>%
#  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(cancer_0223, cancer_0224, cancer_0225, cancer_0454, cancer_0456, cancer_0457, healthy_036, healthy_037, healthy_785, healthy_786, healthy_787, healthy_789), names_to = "sample", values_to = "beta") %>% mutate(type = substr(sample, 1, 1)) %>% filter(seqnames.x %in% plot.chr,
       #                         start.x >= plot.region.start,
      #                          start.x <= plot.region.end)
    all_b <- all_b %>%
      mutate(type = substr(sample, 1, 1)) %>%
      filter(seqnames %in% plot.chr,
                                start >= plot.region.start,
                                start <= plot.region.end)
    
    if(style == "line") {
      b_plot <- all_b %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start, y = beta, colour = type)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw() +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("c" = "#C0622A", "h" = "#1B3A6B"),
                           labels = c("c" = "cancer", "h" = "healthy")) +
        labs(x = "genomic position")
    } else if (style == "smooth") {
      b_plot <- all_b %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start, y = beta, colour = type)) +
        geom_smooth() +
        theme_bw() +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("c" = "#C0622A", "h" = "#1B3A6B"),
                           labels = c("c" = "cancer", "h" = "healthy")) +
        labs(x = "genomic position")
    }
    else {
    b_plot <- all_b %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start, y = beta, colour = type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
      theme_bw() +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("c" = "#C0622A", "h" = "#1B3A6B"),
                         labels = c("c" = "cancer", "h" = "healthy")) +
      labs(x = "genomic position")
    }
    
    patchwork::wrap_plots(plot + ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = plot.space, b = plot.space)),
        b_plot,
        ncol = 1, heights = c(1, plot.height)
    )
}
```

betas_pos <- betas_healthy %>% distinct(seqnames, start) %>% .[order(.$start),] %>% group_by(seqnames) %>% mutate(index = 1:n(), index = paste0(seqnames, ":", index))
betas_pos <- betas_pos %>% ungroup() %>% data.frame()

```{r}
betas_healthy_wide <- betas_healthy %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(sum_col = meth_count_pos + unmeth_count_pos) %>% filter(sum_col > 10) %>% .[,c(1:3,6)] %>% .[order(.$start),] %>% pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = beta)
betas_healthy_wide <- betas_healthy_wide %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(pos = paste0(seqnames, ":", start)) %>% data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(index = betas_pos[match(.$pos, betas_pos$pos), "index"])
```
```{r}
betas_healthy_wide_filt <- na.omit(betas_healthy_wide)
```

```{r}

# Define sample columns
sample_cols <- c("healthy_037", "healthy_787", "healthy_786",
                 "healthy_785", "healthy_789", "healthy_036")
n_samples <- length(sample_cols)

# 1. Flag rows where majority (> half) of samples are in [0.4, 0.6]
df <- betas_healthy_wide_filt %>%
  mutate(
    n_in_range       = rowSums(across(all_of(sample_cols), ~ .x >= 0.4 & .x <= 0.6)),
    majority_in_range = n_in_range > n_samples / 2
  )

# 2. Parse the index column into chromosome and numeric index
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    chr_part = sub(":.*", "", index),
    idx_num  = as.integer(sub(".*:", "", index))
  )

# 3. Detect consecutive runs (same chr, idx increments by 1)
df <- df %>%
  arrange(chr_part, idx_num) %>%
  group_by(chr_part) %>%
  mutate(
    new_run = majority_in_range != lag(majority_in_range, default = !majority_in_range[1]) |
              idx_num != lag(idx_num, default = idx_num[1] - 1) + 1,
    run_id  = cumsum(new_run)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 4. Summarise the consecutive runs
consecutive_runs <- df %>%
  filter(majority_in_range) %>%
  group_by(chr_part, run_id) %>%
  summarise(
    start_index  = first(index),
    end_index    = last(index),
    start_pos    = first(start),
    end_pos      = last(start),
    n_positions  = n(),
    mean_n_in_range = mean(n_in_range),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_positions >= 2)   # adjust: >= 1 to keep single-position hits too

print(consecutive_runs)
```

* with the nas
```{r}
sample_cols <- c("healthy_037", "healthy_787", "healthy_786",
                 "healthy_785", "healthy_789", "healthy_036")

df <- betas_healthy_wide %>%
  mutate(
    n_non_na    = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(sample_cols)))),
    n_in_range  = rowSums(across(all_of(sample_cols), ~ !is.na(.x) & .x >= 0.4 & .x <= 0.6)),
    majority_in_range = n_non_na > 0 & n_in_range > n_non_na / 2
  )

# Parse index
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    chr_part = sub(":.*", "", index),
    idx_num  = as.integer(sub(".*:", "", index))
  )

# Detect consecutive runs
df <- df %>%
  arrange(chr_part, idx_num) %>%
  group_by(chr_part) %>%
  mutate(
    new_run = majority_in_range != lag(majority_in_range, default = !majority_in_range[1]) |
              idx_num != lag(idx_num, default = idx_num[1] - 1) + 1,
    run_id  = cumsum(new_run)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Summarise
consecutive_runs <- df %>%
  filter(majority_in_range) %>%
  group_by(chr_part, run_id) %>%
  summarise(
    start_index     = first(index),
    end_index       = last(index),
    start_pos    = first(start),
    end_pos      = last(start),
    n_positions     = n(),
    min_n_non_na    = min(n_non_na),   # so you can see data density
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_positions >= 2)

print(consecutive_runs)
```
